# Security, Entitlement, and Operations Checklist: Central Offline License Server

**Purpose**: Reviewer gate for whether security, entitlement, outage, recovery, and operational
requirements are complete, unambiguous, consistent, and objectively testable
**Created**: 2026-09-07
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature
context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark
an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements
quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Assessment Legend**:

- **Covered**: The current specification contains an objectively testable requirement.
- **Ambiguous**: The topic exists, but at least one material outcome or boundary is underspecified.
- **Gap**: The necessary requirement is absent from the feature specification.

## Vendor Security Requirements

- [ ] CHK001 Does the specification isolate vendor signing private keys from customer runtime,
  source, distributions, APIs, logs, and default artifacts? **Assessment: Covered.** [Completeness,
  Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK002 Is commercial-license authenticity defined as asymmetric signature verification with
  rejection after any protected payload change? **Assessment: Covered.** [Clarity, Spec §FR-004,
  §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK003 Is activation-certificate signature validation explicitly required independently from
  commercial-license validation? **Assessment: Covered.** [Completeness, Spec §FR-017–FR-018]
- [ ] CHK004 Are supported and unsupported commercial, activation, cache, and envelope schema
  versions defined with deterministic rejection behavior? **Assessment: Covered.** [Coverage, Spec
  §FR-001, §FR-006, §FR-018; Contracts]
- [x] CHK005 Does the feature specification require a deterministic canonical signing
  representation rather than relying on ordinary object serialization? **Assessment: Covered.**
  RFC 8785, domain separation, schema rejection, and exact verification behavior are now explicit.
  [Clarity, Spec §FR-004A]

## License Server Requirements

- [ ] CHK006 Are first-start identity generation, UNACTIVATED state, unique server ID, key pair, and
  creation metadata objectively specified? **Assessment: Covered.** [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK007 Are identity persistence and same-identity restart requirements explicit, including
  separation of the private key from routine backups? **Assessment: Covered.** [Clarity, Spec
  §FR-014, §FR-020A, §FR-062]
- [ ] CHK008 Are activation-request contents, prohibited private material, nonce, and public-key
  binding fully specified? **Assessment: Covered.** [Completeness, Spec §FR-014–FR-016]
- [ ] CHK009 Are activation-import checks complete for both signatures, schemas, customer/license
  correspondence, server identity, policy, and time validity? **Assessment: Covered.** [Coverage,
  Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK010 Does the specification define an objectively testable denial when license and
  activation files are copied to an independently initialized second server? **Assessment: Covered.**
  [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-019, §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK011 Are restart requirements defined for identity, activation, registrations,
  assignments, meters, and absolute lease expiry? **Assessment: Covered.** [Completeness, Spec
  §FR-035B, §FR-062, §SC-007]
- [x] CHK012 Does renewal define activation reuse and current-period usage preservation, and also
  define what happens when renewed limits are below current assignments or active leases?
  **Assessment: Covered.** Reduced-limit renewal preserves recorded state, blocks new allocations
  until below limit, lets leases expire normally, and immediately applies removed entitlements.
  [Clarity, Spec §FR-020, §FR-045A]
- [ ] CHK013 Are subscription expiration boundaries and post-grace denial requirements explicit and
  locally enforceable? **Assessment: Covered.** [Clarity, Spec §FR-006–FR-007, User Story 7]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the seven-day grace policy explicit about eligible existing subjects, prohibited new
  registrations, decision reasons, and cache upper bounds? **Assessment: Covered.** [Completeness,
  Spec §FR-007A, §FR-049, §SC-013]

- [ ] CHK047 Is final-unit usage concurrency required to allow at most one winning request and never

- [ ] CHK048 Is AI usage explicitly aggregated across every environment and installation in the

## Outage Requirement Coverage

- [ ] CHK049 Does the specification distinguish vendor disconnection from temporary customer
  License Server unavailability and define runtime behavior for both? **Assessment: Covered.**
  [Scenario Coverage, Spec §FR-047, User Story 6]
- [ ] CHK050 Are cached-entitlement issuance, signer identity, instance binding, contents, and
  maximum validity specified? **Assessment: Covered.** [Completeness, Spec §FR-048–FR-049]
- [ ] CHK051 Are local signature, expiry, server/instance binding, and modification checks required
  before cached entitlement use? **Assessment: Covered.** [Security Coverage, Spec §FR-050]
- [ ] CHK052 Is cached-entitlement expiration bounded to 24 hours and never beyond commercial
  validity or grace expiry? **Assessment: Covered.** [Clarity, Spec §FR-049]
- [ ] CHK053 Does every outage-sensitive operation have an explicit fail-open or fail-closed rule,
  including zero offline AEU and denial of new allocations? **Assessment: Covered.** [Completeness,
  Spec §FR-051–FR-054, §FR-065]
- [ ] CHK054 Is client recovery defined to resume heartbeat or reacquire capacity and stop licensed
  operation if capacity is denied after reconnection? **Assessment: Covered.** [Recovery Coverage,
  Spec §FR-054A]

## Tamper-Resistance Requirement Coverage

- [ ] CHK055 Is any protected commercial-license payload modification required to produce a
  deterministic rejection before entitlement grant? **Assessment: Covered.** [Security Acceptance,
  Spec §FR-004, §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK056 Are modified activation fields, mismatched artifacts, and invalid activation signatures
  all addressed as rejection scenarios? **Assessment: Covered.** [Edge Case Coverage, Spec §FR-018,
  Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK057 Are server and product identity mismatches required to fail with stable, distinct reason
  codes? **Assessment: Covered.** [Clarity, Spec §FR-019, §FR-022A, Required Reason Codes]
- [ ] CHK058 Is clock rollback quantified by a five-minute tolerance with explicit blocked
  operations and recovery state? **Assessment: Covered.** [Measurability, Spec §FR-064–FR-064A]
- [ ] CHK059 Is persistent-state corruption required to fail closed with STATE_INTEGRITY_FAILURE
  rather than silently reconstructing entitlement? **Assessment: Covered.** [Security Coverage,
  Spec §FR-063]
- [ ] CHK060 Is restoration of a database older than the local trusted checkpoint required to enter
  RECOVERY_REQUIRED and deny new allocation and usage? **Assessment: Covered.** [Recovery Coverage,
  Spec §FR-063A]
- [ ] CHK061 Are software-only VM-cloning limits and the absence of advanced full-clone detection
  explicitly stated without weakening ordinary artifact-copy rejection? **Assessment: Covered.**
  [Assumption, Spec §FR-020C, Out of Scope]

- [ ] CHK062 Is product-instance authentication based on possession of a generated private key,
  with protected requests attributable to the registered public identity? **Assessment: Covered.**
  [Security Coverage, Spec §FR-022–FR-022A]
- [ ] CHK063 Is internal HTTPS mandatory for signed product requests rather than merely a future
  recommendation? **Assessment: Covered.** [Clarity, Spec §FR-022A]
- [ ] CHK064 Does the specification require the transport contract to permit future mTLS without
  replacing logical instance identity? **Assessment: Covered.** [Evolution Coverage, Spec §FR-022A]
- [ ] CHK065 Are logs, audit, status, and diagnostics prohibited from exposing vendor/server private
  keys, seeds, authentication secrets, and equivalent material? **Assessment: Covered.**
  [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, §FR-061]
- [ ] CHK066 Are root-administrator, full-state rollback, binary modification, and software-only
  clone limitations documented as residual risks rather than solved claims? **Assessment: Covered.**

## Operational Requirement Coverage

- [x] CHK067 Does the feature specification require a consistent authoritative-state backup
  operation, define what is included, and provide measurable success/failure outcomes?
  **Assessment: Covered.** The requirement now specifies a coordinated SQLite snapshot, integrity
  verification, no overwrite, incomplete-file cleanup, and no source mutation on failure.
  [Clarity, Spec §FR-020A]
- [ ] CHK068 Are same-installation restore, identity matching, stale-backup detection, and
  RECOVERY_REQUIRED behavior objectively defined? **Assessment: Covered.** [Recovery Coverage, Spec
  §FR-020A, §FR-063A]
- [ ] CHK069 Is migration to new hardware explicitly required to create a new identity and use
  offline reactivation? **Assessment: Covered.** [Clarity, Spec §FR-020B]
- [ ] CHK070 Are support diagnostics required to expose license, activation, utilization, warning,
  and non-secret decision context without vendor connectivity? **Assessment: Covered.**
  [Completeness, Spec §FR-055, §SC-010]
- [ ] CHK071 Are all meaningful decisions required to use stable reason codes and auditable context,
  with minimum codes enumerated? **Assessment: Covered.** [Traceability, Spec §FR-037, §FR-059–FR-060,
  Required Reason Codes]
- [x] CHK072 Does the feature specification define distinct liveness, readiness, identity, storage,
  and activation health semantics with objectively testable outcomes? **Assessment: Covered.**
  Diagnostic liveness and readiness gates for identity, migration, integrity, and recovery are now
  explicit, and activation/expiry remain observable details. [Clarity, Spec §FR-067]

## Notes

- All items are intentionally unchecked. The assessment text is an initial requirements review, not
  reviewer approval and not evidence of implementation.
- Explicitly excluded database-service and packaging technologies are not checklist criteria;
  backup and local-runtime operability are assessed independently of them.
- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify`
  and `$speckit-clarify`.
- Add reviewer findings inline and preserve sequential checklist IDs.
